data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
Greetings, earthbound traveler! I am Professor Orion Starweaver — astronomer, celestial cartographer, and currently the only person in this house paying attention to the sky.
Which, given that the sky holds all the answers, is frankly embarrassing for everyone else.

choices.text: I'm looking for a diary — from the Dreamer.
What are you studying up here?

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text: Yes? I'm rather busy. The upper atmosphere isn't going to chart itself.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
The diary — yes, I have it. Isabelle lent it to me years ago. The visions in it correspond to genuine stellar events; quite remarkable.
I won't simply hand it over, however. Knowledge requires reciprocity.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
Isabelle. Untethered, which is my professional assessment.
I have her diary — she lent it to me for research. Her visions are extraordinarily accurate by stellar standards.
I've been meaning to return it, but I've needed my equipment first.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
The temporal distortions in this house correspond directly to planetary alignments — I've charted over three hundred correlations.
But my equipment has been scattered and I can't complete the work.
Which, incidentally, also prevents me from returning something I owe Isabelle.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
I need two things. My telescope — it was in the study on the ground floor when I last saw it.
And my star chart, which I locked in a box downstairs. The three-digit combination is engraved on a stone plaque in the garden.
The Gardener will know where the plaque is.
Both items. Then the diary is yours.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
Still need both items — telescope and star chart.
You have {item_count:item=Telescope|bool:the telescope/no telescope} and {item_count:item=Star Chart|bool:the star chart/no star chart}.
Telescope: ground floor study. Star chart: locked box downstairs, combination on a stone plaque in the garden.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
Excellent — the telescope! {item_count:item=Telescope|round} of 2 items collected.
Still need the star chart from the locked box downstairs.
Combination is on a stone plaque in the garden. The Gardener will point you to it.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
The star chart — superb. {item_count:item=Star Chart|round} of 2 items, after a fashion.
Still need the telescope. Ground floor study, I believe.
Bring it up here and we have a deal.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
Both! Telescope AND star chart — you are extraordinarily capable for someone who isn't an astronomer.
With these I can resume my observations of the temporal distortions in the upper atmosphere.
The patterns have been quite clear, once you know how to read them.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
The diary — there. A fair exchange between professionals.
Return it to Isabelle. She is in the west wing and she has been untethered without it.
The visions in those pages are genuine, incidentally. The stars confirmed several of them.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
Obtained Personal Diary
Take it to Isabelle — west wing.

data.speaker: Astronomer
data.text:
The diary is with Isabelle now, which is correct.
I can see {keys_collected|round} of the 4 celestial alignments forming already — the curse is weakening.
Find whoever holds the remaining {flag:keys_remaining|round} {flag:keys_remaining|plural:key/keys}.
